quotes.text: Bug 1897010 followed the initial EWS header-fetch patch after Rust warnings caused a Brust Treeherder build failure. The follow-up marks future-proof match arms with #[allow(unreachable_patterns)] and unused work-in-progress bindings with underscore names. D210579 reviewer compared the patch to build errors and asked for one line to be formatted; the accepted review did not include an independent Rust build. This is a build lesson, not a recommendation to suppress warnings broadly. The unimplemented EWS branches remained unimplemented.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
